DataType.Name: IsPrimary
DataType.Comment: The command can interrupt the program (True: Primary / False: Auxiliary) [Sig: 2401]

DataType.Name: Id_Primary
DataType.Comment: Id number of the command done by primary task

DataType.Name: Id_Secondary
DataType.Comment: Id number of the command done by secondary task

DataType.Name: Waiting
DataType.Comment: Primary task is waiting on movement [Sig: 2418]

DataType.Name: Busy_Primary
DataType.Comment: Primary task is busy with a command [Sig: 2419]

DataType.Name: Busy_Auxiliary
DataType.Comment: Secondary task is busy with a command [Sig: 2420]

DataType.Name: InFault
DataType.Comment: Robot in fault and waiting for reset command [Sig: 2421]

DataType.Name: Resetting
DataType.Comment: Resetting system after robot power has been turned off

DataType.Name: FatalError
DataType.Comment: A fatal error has occurred and robot power cannot be turned on

DataType.Name: WaitingPower
DataType.Comment: Waiting for user to turn on robot power

DataType.Name: Initalizing
DataType.Comment: Robot power was just turned on; initialization is occurring

DataType.Name: ManualControl
DataType.Comment: Indicates that Manual control mode is active

DataType.Name: Calibrating
DataType.Comment: A CALIBRATE command or instruction is executing

DataType.Name: NotCalibrated
DataType.Comment: Robot power is on; robot is not calibrated and cannot be moved

DataType.Name: LightBlinkSlow
DataType.Comment: Front panel power light is blinking slowly (1 Hz), waiting to be pressed. Robot power will be turned on when the blinking button is pressed

DataType.Name: LighrBlinkFast
DataType.Comment: Front panel power light is blinking rapidly (4 Hz). Robot power will be turned on when: the COMP/PWR button on the pendant is pressed

DataType.Name: Moving
DataType.Comment: Normal trajectory evaluation is in progress (including normal acceleration, deceleration and segment transitions)

DataType.Name: MotionDone
DataType.Comment: Motion stopped at a planned location

DataType.Name: ErrorPosition
DataType.Comment: Position error is being nulled at unplanned final location

DataType.Name: Stop_Belt
DataType.Comment: Motion stopped at an unplanned location due to a belt window violation

DataType.Name: Brake_Stopping
DataType.Comment: Decelerating due to a triggered REACTI or BRAKE instruction

DataType.Name: Brake_Stopped
DataType.Comment: Stopped due to a triggered REACTI or BRAKE instruction

DataType.Name: ES_Stopping
DataType.Comment: Decelerating due to a hardware error, panic button, or ESTOP instruction

DataType.Name: ES_Stopped
DataType.Comment: Stopped due to a hardware error, panic button, or ESTOP instruction

DataType.Name: Force_Stopping
DataType.Comment: Decelerating due to a stop-on-force condition

DataType.Name: Force_Stopped
DataType.Comment: Stopped due to a stop-on-force condition

DataType.Name: Spin_Nullung
DataType.Comment: Nulling at completion of a SPIN motion

DataType.Name: Spin_Stopped
DataType.Comment: Stopped after completion of a SPIN instruction

DataType.Name: PressHighPowerWhenBlinking
DataType.Comment: Press HIGH POWER button when blinking

DataType.Name: McpEnableSwitchRequired
DataType.Comment: Push, release, hold, MCP enable switch

DataType.Name: PressHighPowerToEnablePower
DataType.Comment: Press HIGH POWER button to enable power

DataType.Name: ProtectedReadOnlyProgramsNotStored
